items.title: 7.7 Nataij aur faislon ka abalagh (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 7.7 before its first sub-heading (PDF 102-102); each sub-heading has its own lesson.

blocks.text: Nataij aur nateeje (conclusions) batana data analysis aur research ka aham qadam hai. Is se parhne wale samajhte hain ke data kya dikhata hai aur kaun se faisle kiye ja sakte hain. Wazeh tareeqe se batane se nataij ki ghalat-fehmi ya ghalat istemal nahi hota. Researchers ko nataij saade aur mantiqi andaz mein samjhane chahiye. Nateeje sirf analyze kiye gaye data par mabni hon. Achhi communication transparency aur saakh barhati hai, aur achhi reporting aage ki research aur faislon mein bhi madad deti hai.
